name: concise-capture-projection
goal: Screenshot cards stay concise and preserve identical-tree images across projections without exposing cache filenames.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Header captions are redundant. Separately, main 9fb0505e PR32 added cache-filename forwarding to preserve identical-tree images, violating the existing Desktop projection contract. The unchanged recorded-projection test fails at its no-side assertion; header red/green proof is retained at 5c6ef994 and ca66f810.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: PR32 browser and Reports checks missed the directly changed Desktop projection guard. Extend its existing derivation matrix with identical-tree and changed-tree focused captures, own getters, iterators and species, and fresh latency/process-memory observations; retain the standard header matrix. Harness guidance now names the projection boundary tests.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red 0c6b8f55 at 0fc3bfd9 reproduces four projection filename failures, the header render failure and six responsive header failures. The three canonical route cases pass; 165 original screenshots and 400 runtime observations are retained. Admission fixtures do not produce setup errors.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Carry the verified opaque source-tree hash through entity projections and accept it in focused capture selection; keep legacy raw-history locators internal. Remove the two header items. The normal projection matrix guards identity, provenance, changed-tree rejection and filename isolation; isolated mutations will prove both original failures are rejected.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: EntityScreens has revision-only captions with image activation preserved. HarnessRevision carries opaque sourceTree identity; the projection copies only a proof-matched hash and focused selection accepts it without forwarding side filenames. Existing contracts and Harness instructions are synchronized; targeted projection/answer tests pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
